programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: The Isle of Man lies in the midst of the Irish Sea between Ireland and England. Officially, it belongs to the Queen, yet it has its own laws and its own currency. Its crest is the 'three legs' that symbolise its resilient people. The island holds a fascinating history of Viking settlement.

programme.title: Crossing South
programme.desc: Bone marrow for breakfast, Cat sterilization at midday, and Lobster for dinner.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: Separated by less than an hour or so by boat via the famous Danube you’ll find two major cities that, though proximate to each other, could not be more different. Not long ago, Bratislava and Vienna were at the edge, but opposite ends of the fabled Iron Curtain, which divided much more than just ideology. The crew explores the resulting and fascinating contrasts recent history has imposed, but mostly, shows travelers how they can have a good time appreciating the very different charms of each city.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this second episode, we sail into Venice and visit our friend Renato, who has been the head chef at the Cipriani Hotel for over 25 years and has travelled the world as a food ambassador. Renato invites us into his kitchen to make some of his best-loved Venetian dishes. We then visit the famous Rialto markets and cook a few of my favourites in the yacht’s galley. We conclude our Venice adventure by visiting some friends at an old gondola repair yard called a squero. It has been converted into a private retreat featuring an impressive kitchen, from which we experience a memorable Venetian cook-up.

It explores diverse cities and historical sites while experiencing the cultural and archaeological features of these unique locations.

programme.title: Raw Travel
programme.desc: One of Eastern Europe’s crown jewels and much traveled destinations, Budapest gets the Raw Travel treatment. The crew enlists the help of savvy locals and expats to uncover some of the more hidden and decidedly less touristic charms of Budapest.

programme.title: Food Sail Love
programme.desc: In this episode, we sail all the way to southern Turkey to visit the picturesque village of Kaleköy in the Kekova area. We introduce you to a local family who run the Likya restaurant, and serve simple delicious Turkish food. We’ve known them for over 30 years, ever since we began sailing here. We also discover how the locals love the carob bean, and how they make a tasty, healthy syrup from it. Finally, we’ll introduce you to our friend Kadriye who cooks up a typical Turkish lunch, and one of her neighbours demonstrates how to make the local pancake called gözleme.

programme.title: Andiamo! Uptown
programme.desc: Donna and celebrity comedian Affion Crockett explore the adventure, cuisine, and culture of Negril, Jamaica, that includes a visit to an amazing all-inclusive luxury resort.
